label: ROS2 Upload
title: ROS2 Package Upload
subtitle: Uploads ROS2 packages from the project folder to a remote px4-sim simulation container. Specialist tool for robotics simulation workflows.
whenToUse: Use in ROS2 development workflows where an agent needs to deploy a package to a running simulation container for testing.

methods.name: Upload ROS2 Package
methods.description: Uploads a ROS2 package directory from the project folder to the configured simulation container via HTTP POST.

mediaCaption: A ROS2 package upload action card showing the package name, target container URL, and upload confirmation
